  2. 2

    Set up Jason's house

    SetupJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbMedium priority

    Strength (max health): lift the heaviest weights on the back deck, resting between reps until the game says you need to recover; no gym needed. Cardio (max stamina): hang the punching bag from the storage room / shed and punch until the session ends. Focus (slow-motion time): shoot hoops in the driveway or feed Dolores the snake. Have some protein after a workout: it speeds recovery so you can train twice a day (Caspahz). Then sleep in your bed to skip to the next day and train again; the stats video says this maxes Strength and Cardio in a couple of hours. Read the Fishing Magazine and check the mailbox for cash. Repairing the house raises your relationship with LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb; leaving the walls unpainted lowers it a little. Jay Dunna's Chapter 1 walkthrough: repair the house before Lucia comes home (walls, the deck by the door, the stairs, the leaky roof via the ladder, then paint), and hang the hidden punching bag for a home workout spot she likes. Feed Dolores, and do Lucia's shopping, flowers and clothes from AndyFirst appearance · CharacterAndyPlayed by Mallory WuMallory Wu on IMDb before picking her up.

    How to find it: next to JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's House in Key LentoReal lifeKey Largo, with bits of Islamorada30 of 54 GTADB landmark matches here are in Key Largo.. Real-world counterpart (GTADB): 12522 FL-24, Cedar Key, FL 32625, USA.

  4. 4

    Get around faster: grab a helicopter

    SetupJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbMedium priority

    There is no real fast travel. A pontoon helicopter is docked at a small building in Pelican ValleyReal lifeEverglades swamp country west of HomesteadBest guess from the name and fan comparisons. (closest to JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's house; the NPCs there shoot a little) and another floats at an oil/gas platform further north; the Southwind airfield has one too. Land it in the water by Jason's dock and drop the anchor from the vehicle menu. It cannot be refuelled, so treat it as a burner, and land away from enemy camps. Also useful: saving and immediately loading that save puts you back at home, and holding down on the D-pad then the cinematic button lets the car or boat auto-drive to your waypoint. Once you have the RideMe app, request a ride, hold aim on the driver and hold Triangle / Y to skip the trip for $100. 'H' markers on the map are helicopter spawns, but they come and go with the time of day.

  5. 5

    Gear Up

    StoryJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    Unlocks gun shops and loadouts. Buy a suppressor and a body armor vest (it breaks if fully depleted, but re-equipping it repairs it). Pick up a bandana, hat and sunglasses and two or three outfits: toggle the accessories off from the item wheel when the cops have your description, and save outfits to your car to swap during a chase. Weapon colours: blue = bought (kept forever, moddable), yellow = unique (kept forever, fixed mods), white = found (lost if you die or are busted; the trunk keeps one per weapon type). Away from the car you carry two long guns. Sheriff cars carry a free armor vest and guns in the trunk. If the cops saw your weapon, stash it in your trunk; if they know your face, hold Circle / B to duck while driving.

  6. 6

    Know your criminal profile (one tier is permanent)

    SetupBothHigh priority

    JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb each have their own profile, set by how violently you play. Professional (start) and Hardened: incapacitating shots (yellow markers) and stealth takedowns refill Focus, you can surrender at low wanted levels (R1 / RB), and police mostly use tasers. Violent: headshots refill Focus instead. Psycho: no surrender, more lethal police. All four can be moved between. Keep going as a Psycho after the cracked-icon warnings and you become Irredeemable for the rest of the game: no Focus refills at all, police shoot at any crime, no surrender, and the video says some endings are no longer available for Psycho or Irredeemable. Lower your profile with good deeds: helping strangers, petting stray cats, throwing away trash. Newer videos agree: Irredeemable cannot be undone on that save and changes the story and endings, so make a manual save before going on a spree (JorRaptor). Full details on the Criminal profile page.

  8. 8

    Gun Nut house next door: sniper, LMG, rocket launcher, body armor

    LootJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    The house about 0.1 mi from JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's, reachable straight after Pipework. Kick the door in upstairs; the owner is armed. Inside: the unique Gun Nut SMS-01 sniper, a wallet, frag grenades, a Mustang revolver, a safe in the first bedroom (about $250), a scoped 556 rifle on the owner, a shotgun behind the shower and a rocket launcher in the bathroom (climb into the tub), body armor on the bed, a light machine gun, and adrenaline in the garage. You can only carry so many long guns, so pick between the rifle, LMG and rocket launcher (store the rest in your trunk). Two videos show it; one says some players find the house empty, and Detonated still lists the Gun Nut SMS-01 as not found.

    Clear the Key Lento robbery spots

    MoneyJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    Kingfishers Fishing Shacks: DonnieFirst appearance · CharacterDonniePlayed by Brad CarterBrad Carter on IMDb texts you about this camp early in the story. Approach by boat, thin them out with a sniper, then loot the main hut: the Kingfishers W-22 (unique, built-in silencer) is in the weapon crate, there is cash under the floorboards, and two non-unique guns (Duke 556, Laird 350) lie around the camp. One video puts the haul at about $10K including product. Every Kingfisher camp has a unique in its main building, but only while the gang is there: if you missed it, wait for them to regroup. Sunrise RV Park: pry the office safe; the Kingfishers Akulus revolver is on the trailer bed. Driving back later takes 10+ minutes, so do them while you are here.

    StoryJasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDbHigh priority

    Island Dreams unlocks the dive sites, the Island Dreams shop and pawn shops. KentonFirst appearance · CharacterKenton ReesPlayed by Machel MontanoMachel Montano on IMDb's wrecks then appear under Search the Dive Sites: 6 wrecks, 34 treasures (Island Dreams 4, Nuestra Senora de la Noche 7, Etica Laxa 5, Urca de Cinco Torres 6, Lujuriosa 6, Urca de Santa Sierra 6).     • Island Dreams pays $400 no matter how many doubloons you find or what happens to Dobbs.

    • Example site (IGN): the Nuestra Senora de la Etica Laxa south of Key Lento has five: Ancient Snuff Box (south-west, by the mast), Golden Pendant (inside the hull, in a broken box), Golden Chalice (south side, next to a box), Ceremonial Spoon (south-east, in the sand) and the Battered Doubloon (a chest to the south by the coral).

The videos disagree on cash in JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's pockets. One says it survives and that it was triple-checked: sell every stash bag, wait for the BuckMe payment, withdraw it all at an ATM, and empty the house stash before the yacht job with MattiaFirst appearance · CharacterMattia TauroPlayed by Massi PregoniMassi Pregoni on IMDb and Kat. The warning sign is LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb asking whether to call Mattia about the job; say no to buy time. Two other videos and Game8 say all cash is lost and recommend spending it on things that carry over: tattoos and piercings, and guns bought at Ammu-Nation. Make a manual save first either way. Jason's lock box rainy-day envelope and photos can be collected in Chapter 2. A third video (Caspahz) says only the house stash is lost and to move it into the bank, but Game8 and the first video say the BuckMe balance is wiped too.

Choices

Hey Arnold!Kill or spare Arnold? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Spare him. Sparing gives Jason a Restrained criminal profile and a chance to meet Arnold again. Game8 says it pays an extra $10K in Chapter 4; another source calls that payout disputed. Killing gives a Hardened profile.

Steal the Scooter (optional)Steal Peggy's scooter? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Your call. Stealing it lets you drive Shirley's Penumbra in Chapter 1 but can give a wanted level. Skipping it is safe.

Day ReleaseMention Brian's retirement? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Mention it. Raises the relationship and Lucia is supportive afterwards. Staying quiet lowers it during Recalibration.

Day ReleaseShake Mattia's hand / accept the drugs / which dress? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Any. No visible effect. The dress only sets what Lucia wears clubbing in Vice City.

Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (optional)Shoot Mr. Mangrove, shoot Kirk, or neither? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Shoot Mr. Mangrove. The only option that pays: Kirk sends you $5,000. The other two give no reward.

  3. 3

    Before Moses: raid La Cascara Motel for a free Dominator

    StealthStealth tips
    • Go at night: it is easier to stay unseen (Jay Dunna).
    • Crouch along the south side of the 2nd floor and use Focus to see who is looking; two gang members need taking down quietly, the second from the side path by the grow operation (Its Shatter).
    • Take guards from behind: choke them out, or pistol-whip with a suppressed pistol out (Jay Dunna).
    • If the alarm goes up, pull them through the choke point north of the safe room and drop them with knee and elbow shots (Its Shatter).
    • Leave by dropping through the broken floors; the police arrive after the noise (Jay Dunna).
    LootLuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDbHigh priority

    After Girl's Trip, MosesFirst appearance · CharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb' first registration is free, so bring him the best car you can. The derelict La Cascara Motel near Gellhorn Outfitters (Kolt & Associates gang) has the red/black Vapid Firebug Dominator out front: nitrous, no tracker. Stealth route: 2nd floor south side, metal stairs on the west to the 3rd floor, the caved-in ceiling as a ramp to the 4th. The Lieutenant's room safe is 6969 (about $3,000) and a gun case on the way to the north stairwell holds the Scrapper VF5C, a suppressed SMG that is great for non-lethal takedowns. Leave through the hole in the floor past the locked gate, take the Dominator and jump the water from the trailer park; Moses is about 0.3 miles away. If it is not your free car it costs about $3,000 to register. Three videos agree on the code and the car. Jay Dunna adds a grenade launcher on the top floor and an LMG on a lower floor, and says the Dominator respawns out front a few days later if you leave it. Go at night and escape by dropping through the broken floors.

    Codes: (Safe 6969)How to unlock: The Lieutenant's room safe is 6969 (about $3,000) and a gun case on the way to the north stairwell holds the Scrapper VF5C, a suppressed SMG that is great for non-lethal takedowns. Three videos agree on the code and the car.

    Moses

    StoryLuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDbHigh priority

    The top-priority mission of the chapter. Unlocks selling and registering vehicles and gives you the Slim Jim (opens cars without the alarm). Your FIRST registration is free: choose Register, not Sell, and bring a standout car (the Firebug Dominator from La Cascara, or Paul Walker's Penumbra FF from a Vespucci Island garage; otherwise either costs $3,000 to $6,750). Scan with WAiNK first: the tracker must be 'none' at this stage, and cars stolen right next to his shop can be refused. Hover his map icon to see whether he takes a car and the price. Vans sell for the most, then trucks. For robberies consider a van: vans hold 10 stash bags, many cars only 2 (Caspahz).     Rebuild Strength and Cardio

    SetupBothLow priority

    Unlike Focus, Strength and Cardio drop if you skip workouts. Lift the heaviest weights at the safe house (no gym needed), use the punching bag for Cardio, then sleep to skip to the next day and go again. Running, swimming, biking and gym machines also count. Free drinks and apples give temporary boosts above your max.

    StealthStealth tips
    • Come in through the gap in the fence on the right-hand side, away from the guards (CovertMF, Jay Dunna).

    • Dre'Quan offers play money: take it for a few extra minutes in the club, or decline for a shorter mission. Nothing else changes.
    • From now on Pay 'n' Spray garages buy stolen cars; the Ubermacht '85 Sentinel you arrive in sells for about $1,760.

    Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs

    StealthStealth tips
    • Rob a jewelry store without being detected for the Sneakthief trophy (PC Gamer, GamesRadar).
    • After the first job the Snap Gun opens locked doors in two seconds and skips alarm systems (jayvee).
    StoryBothHigh priority

    Hit Richardson Jewelry, Donovan Banks & Co and Casa de Empeno, then sell to YasmaniCharacterYasmani CabreraPlayed by Hiram DelgadoHiram Delgado on IMDb. He offers some of the best rates for robbery goods. Rewards the Snap Gun (quick, quiet lockpicking) and opens jewelry store robberies. Jay Dunna: do the store with no back entrance first (the Snap Gun is no help there; office code 1680 in his run), then Donovan Banks & Co, then the last one; the Snap Gun sits in Yasmani's back room after the first job (about $6,300 plus the jewelry). Destroy the footage every time.

    Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Richardson Jewelry (Downtown Vice CityReal lifeDowntown Miami and Brickell105 of 105 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.), Donovan Banks & Co (Peacock BayReal lifeCoconut Grove, famous for its wild peacocks36 of 52 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.), Casa de Empeno (Ocean BeachReal lifeSouth Beach and Ocean Drive283 of 289 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami Beach.) (Code 1680)How to unlock: office code 1680 in his run), then Donovan Banks & Co, then the last one. Rewards the Snap Gun (quick, quiet lockpicking) and opens jewelry store robberies. the code is on a sticky note on the lit workbench in the far back room.

    More detail (10)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
    • Richardson Jewelry: diamond ring, at least $9,000. The safe is in the room behind the shop by the windows; the code is on a sticky note on the lit workbench in the far back room. The alarm panel is in that back room and the footage sits under a whiteboard behind the shop. The back alley door is alarmed.
    • Donovan Banks & Co: amethyst necklace, about $4,700. The safe is beside the fridge under the TV; the code is on a green note above the office desk, and the alarm panel and footage are in the office too. The back garage door opens without an alarm.
    • Casa de Empeno: buffalo skull chain, about $6,300. Safe, alarm and footage are all in the office; the code is on a green note on the staff-room cork board. The front door is the only way out.
    • Your first job unlocks the Snap Gun (opens locked doors quietly). The second unlocks pickup from your garage, which pays less.
    • Sell to Yasmani as soon as you lose the cops: if you die or get arrested, the haul in the trunk is gone.
    • Destroy the footage (Focus finds it) and park with the trunk open by your exit. Sticky Bombs open coded safes without the code.
    • After his first three jobs (the ATM and payday-loan ones) you can call Yasmani every day for a paid tip. His spots show as purple icons and pay far more: a small shop that gave about $10,000 paid $56,000 in one video, with a special diamond on some days.
    • Later he gives you free sticky bombs every day, and drop-off points through his vape shop (for a fee that drops as you work with him). You can sell straight from a car parked next to him instead of carrying the bags in.
    • He pays the most for jewelry and marked bills; Tyrone pays the most for narcotics (second video).

Sending your partner to fence the loot is faster but paid far less in one test ($17,000 against $35,000).

  28. 28

    The Cartel Heist

    FinaleBothHigh priority

    Starts once every main mission is done. Move fast so you have as much time as possible in the vault section. Completing it ends Chapter 3.

    Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Sinfrontera National Bank, Vice CityReal lifeMiami600 of 641 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.; ends at the Port of Vice City

    How to find it: next to The Hub Gallery in StockyardReal lifeMiami's industrial west side27 of 27 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.. Real-world counterpart (GTADB): 450 NW 28th St, Miami, FL 33127, USA.

    More detail (8)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
    • Refill ammo from Raul's bag in the lobby. Search the SWAT truck for the smoke grenade launcher.
    • Protect Nicole through the basement: if she dies, you restart. The water cooler at the basement entrance buffs you.
    • On the bus, shoot tyres and drivers. Use Combat Focus on the helicopter and take the exit Raul calls.
    • Perfect run (one video, about 10 minutes): make a hard save at Raul's first. In the bank, knock out the first guard with a pistol, then threaten each group toward the centre room; stop the runners shown as red dots and the customer heading for the alarm at the back. Knock out anyone who will not move.
    • As Lucia, walk the security guard into the security room and keep intimidating him until the alarm is off and the driver is set up; only knock him out when the prompt changes. Take the adrenaline and Zombix in that room.
    • As Jason, clear the floors with kneecap shots (focus mode helps) to stay Professional, then the roof.
    • The vault cable is the hard part: thread it between the red-and-white cables. If Lucia says 'God damn it', use Retry checkpoint straight away; 'get right up on it... perfect' means you get the full 55 seconds. The video found it easier with Simplified minigames off.
    • In the vault grab the middle stacks first, then the second side, then the left; marked bills last. Done this way it paid about $10.5 million and there was no police chase.

    Reward / unlocks: Break the Bank trophy

Choices

Welcome to Vice CityTake the money? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. Taking it means spending all of it on the dancers before you can continue. Declining skips ahead to meeting Boobie.

Dealer's ChoicePure or Cut product? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Pure (no fight). Pure: the deal goes off without a hitch. Cut: Game8's choices page says you get only half the money and may fight the buyers with a wanted level, but its chapter walkthrough says Cut pays more. The two Game8 pages disagree.

Dealer's ChoiceWhich song hook? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. Only changes the lyrics of 'Cooties' on the radio and in cutscenes.

Dubious ProvenanceGive the statue to Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Give it. He hands you a watch as collateral and the story moves on. Refusing only delays it: you have to return to Capri and give it to him anyway.

Dubious ProvenanceTrust Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Trust him (faster). Game8's choices page: trusting avoids a delay of a few days; not trusting means waiting for Evelyn to call and tell you he is a scammer. Game8's walkthrough says the opposite, so sources disagree.

Dubious ProvenanceKill or spare Halifax? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Either. You get his stash both ways. Killing raises your criminal profile, sparing lowers it.

Safe WordJoin the movie shoot? Tap to show the pick.

Pick: Do not join. Raises the relationship. Joining lowers it; the cutscene afterwards is the same.

  18. 18

    Tie Up Loose Ends, Call Valentina Back, Sunset, Starting From Zero

    FinaleBothHigh priority

    The closing missions of the chapter (GamesRadar redacts the last one). Finishing Chapter 4 unlocks Top Of The World, Ma.

    Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: RaulCharacterRaul BautistaPlayed by Manny PerezManny Perez on IMDb's boat; then laying low across Vice CityReal lifeMiami600 of 641 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami. (Leonida's Miami)

    How to find it: next to El Rincón Notorio in Little CubaReal lifeLittle HavanaBest guess from the name and fan comparisons.. Real-world counterpart (GTADB): 1388 SW 8th St, Miami, FL 33135.

    More detail (8)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
    • Calling Valentina back doesn't change the result; if you wait instead, her call takes about three real hours.
    • Sunset: save and buff first. Grab the Boomer Launcher by the escape boat, Ships and Giggles.
    • Starting From Zero: the choices you get depend on the relationship level. Break line of sight from cops (duck in a stopped car). A car hides you better than the Seashark.
    • Sunset is the point of no return, and it only starts when you physically pick up the note at the Y Hotel front desk: after the call and the map marker you can leave the note there for as long as you like and finish everything else first.
    • One guide says the next six or seven missions after Sunset run back to back with no free roam (single source), so buy armour and rifle ammo for BOTH characters before taking the note.
    • Suite 701 and its concierge stop being available once Sunset begins; use the concierge one last time. One guide says there are no missable collectibles in the suite.
    • Several guides say your Buck Me checking balance drops to zero for a while near the end of this chapter (they disagree on whether it comes back). Keep only what you need in checking and move the rest into Family Savings, the one pot nobody reports losing.
    • There is no mission replay: make a manual save in its own slot named 'Before Sunset' and do not overwrite it.

    In the last few missions you get the penthouse in the tower on the small diamond-shaped island (TequestaReal lifeMiami (named after the Tequesta people of the Miami River)52 of 52 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.     After the story: cheats and clean-up

    OptionalBothLow priority

    Cheats only work after you beat the story and meet each cheat's own requirement. Using one disables trophies and saving, so keep a separate save. All Strangers & Freaks questlines are still available in free roam.

    More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
    • For 100%: at least 70 of the 80 challenges (The Long Road trophy), 300 stunts across all stunt types (130 are stunt jumps, 53 of them in Vice-Dale County; 250 count for Cunning Stunts), and 108 WAiNK scans (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, 4 Peewees billboards, 15 No Flusher tags). Activities include 39 races, 12 shooting ranges and 42 drone races (IGN).

Every mission, in order (192)

Party Hard Work Personal Security · Chapter 4 · Either
Starts
Vice-Dale County, VCIA
Needs
Complete Chapter 4 "Lawyer Up"
Who
Either
From
Valentina
  1. How it starts

    Valentina offers a security job for the Megamundo HQ opening after Lawyer Up. Meet her at VCIA.

  2. Follow the car

    You drive Andres: follow the lead car out of the airport.

  3. Pick up Andrés' order

    Detour to Little Cuba to collect his drink order.

  4. Drive to the Megamundo offices

    Drive on to the Megamundo offices Downtown.

  5. Follow Andrés
  6. Follow Petra

    Ride the lift up with Petra and the others.

  7. Check on Andrés

    In the conference room kidnappers take Andres. Knock the gun from the man left behind, then knock him out.

  8. Pick up the radio

    Clear the floor, then take the radio from the marked body.

  9. Go to the stairwell

    As Lucia, crouch along the left side to the stairwell and win the button-mash fight there.

  10. Eliminate the gunmen

    Clear the party floor with the silenced pistol. You have no spare ammo, so make shots count; Focus highlights enemies.

  11. Rescue the Navarros

    Check on the Navarros behind the marked door.

  12. Get in the helicopter

    As Jason, sprint to the rooftop helicopter, jump on and win the fight inside.

  13. Land on the helipad

    Fly back and land on the Megamundo helipad.

Summarised in our words from PowerPyx's walkthrough ↗ · Chapter 4

Photo/Shoot Shoot a Promo · Chapter 4 · Either
Starts
Vice City, Tequesta
Needs
Complete Chapter 4 "Party Hard"
Who
Either
From
Dre'Quan
Reward
$6,000 + Roxy's W-10 SMG weapon variant + Bae-Luxe's W-10 weapon variant
  1. How it starts

    After Party Hard, Dre'Quan asks for help with a Real Dimez video in Tequesta. Follow him to the roof.

  2. Photograph the Dimez

    As Lucia in the helicopter, use the phone camera to photograph the Dimez posing.

  3. Chase after Dre'Quan's car

    As Jason, fly after Dre'Quan's car; when it enters a building switch to Lucia on a bike. You cannot shoot the car, just keep up.

  4. Rescue Dre'Quan

    Fight up to Dre'Quan. Under the highway watch for cars arriving on the right and garage doors opening on the left.

Needs

From

Reward
KD's SFB 1000 race bike
  1. How it starts

    A few in-game days after Photo/Shoot, Dre'Quan says he left you something in La Perle.

  2. Collect Dre'Quan's gift

    The KD's SFB 1000 race bike is in the alley behind the Pay 'n' Spray. Keep it if you have no race bike: it is very fast once upgraded.

Tail the Security Van Chapter 4 · Optional · Either
Starts
Vice City, Little Cuba
Needs
Complete Chapter 4 That's Where the Money Is… + Pay Yasmani $10,000 for a robbery tip
Who
Either
From
Yasmani
Reward
Dependent on location and how much you steal, typically around $100,000 from Marked Bills in the bank vault
  1. How it starts

    After That's Where the Money Is, pay Yasmani $10,000 for a van tip and go to the marked spot.

  2. Tail the security van

    Follow the van to its bank from a distance; too close and the driver will not stop.

  3. Rob the vault

    Wait until the guard walks to the vault, then go in. Expect a keypad door to break and guards who shoot on sight.

  4. Lose the cops

    Always four stars, and police are usually waiting outside. Sell the marked bills to Yasmani afterwards.

  1. How it starts

    From Chapter 4, after his earlier tips, Yasmani sells tips for small banks, including the safe code.

  2. Rob the banks

    Use the Snap Gun on a locked teller door to avoid the alarm; a keypad door to the back needs a sticky bomb.

Vice City, Little Cuba
Needs
Complete Yasmani's Payday Loan Jobs at least once
Who
Either
From
Yasmani
Reward
$15,000
  1. How it starts

    After doing his payday loan tips once, Yasmani may ask for a necklace from one of four stores in Rockridge. It can be missed.

  2. Find the Gold Blammer

    It is at Vice City Gun & Pawn, so you can skip the other three.

  3. Steal the necklace

    Deal with the store's security; the necklace is in a locked box on the back-room desk.

  4. Sell the Gold Blammer

    Sell it to Yasmani for $15,000.

    After his jewelry jobs and Credit Check, pay Yasmani $1,000 for a tip (do his ATM jobs first or let them expire).

Prologue Chapter 1 · Lucia
Starts
Hamlet Prison
Needs
None, start the game
Who
Lucia
  1. Talk to your cell mates

    Lucia starts at her cell window: turn round and talk to her cell mates.

  2. Go with the prison guard

    Follow CO Wilson to the counsellor's office; he stops for a phone call on the way.

  3. Threaten the teller and grab the cash

    A flashback: aim at the payday loan teller, threaten him and take the cash.

  4. Lose the cops

    You cannot actually escape; the chase ends in a cutscene.

  5. Return to the coffee shop

    Walk back to the coffee shop marked on the minimap.

Summarised in our words from PowerPyx's walkthrough ↗ · Chapter 1

Gone Fishing Chapter 1 · Jason
Starts
Mariana County
Needs
starts immediately after Prologue
Who
Jason
From
Cal
Reward
Jason's House in Key Lento
  1. Follow the Plane & Collect the Packages

    On the boat with Cal, follow Donnie's plane and slow down by each dropped package to collect it.

  2. Search the camp for Donnie

    At the docks Jason goes on alone. You can stay in stealth: crouch and choke enemies out from behind.

  3. Find a Way into the Shack & Untie Donnie

    Enter the shack by the front, untie Donnie, beat the brute with your fists and take the Zombix.

  4. Head to the Plane

    On the way to the plane, the red-and-white trailer on the left has your cash inside. It is optional and easy to miss.

  5. Get in the Sea Plane

    Shoot or run through to the plane, healing with Zombix.

  6. Fly back to Brian's Marina

    Fly to the marker, land on the water and taxi to Brian's marina.

Lab Fees Collect Brian's Rent · Chapter 1 · Jason
Starts
Mariana County, Key Lento
Needs
Finished Chapter 1 "Gone Fishing".
Who
Jason
Reward
$600
  1. How it starts

    At the locked boutique, phone Brian, then go in.

  2. Talk to the clerk

    The clerk has no rent. One punch and he offers acid from the back room instead.

  3. Enter the lab and collect acid

    Door code 0420 (also on a notepad in the room). Take the acid; the cash register is yours too.

  4. Call Brian
  5. Stash the acid in Brian's lockup

    Brian's lockup has a green icon; door code 7700. The $600 arrives later in the mailbox outside Jason's house.

  1. How it starts

    Finish the optional errands, then sleep until morning; drive around if she still has not called.

  4. Get in your vehicle
  5. Drive to the bar

  7. Order Lucia and yourself a drink from a bartender

    Order two beers ($6) and carry both to the table.

  8. Meet up with Lucia when you're ready

    Lucia is behind the bar.

  9. Return to Lucia

    Drink the shot on the counter.

  10. Hang out with your friends

    Optional chats: help Cal with his dating app or talk to Donnie. Refusing Donnie's drugs keeps Lucia happy.

  11. Dance with Lucia

    Walk up to Lucia to dance; keep going until Andy arrives.

  12. Find Mattia / Hang out with your friends

    Mattia is on the phone out the back. Offer him a drink and fetch a beer.

  13. Pick up a pool cue, play pool with Mattia

    Take a cue from the wall. The game is always interrupted by the Aviators.

  14. Deal with D-Man

    Fist fight outside: block when you see their shoulders turn.

  15. Follow Lucia

    Run with Lucia before the police arrive; the night ends at home.

Save for the Future Chapter 1 · Jason
Starts
Mariana County, Key Lento
Needs
Finished Chapter 1 "Buck Me (Set Up Bank Account)"

Reward
Upgrades to your BuckMe account at each family saving level (higher checking account limits, passive voucher perks that reduce prices)

  2. Buckin' Broke - $5000 Family Savings

  3. BuckeDry - $10,000 Family Savings

  4. BuckMe Gold - $100,000 Family Savings

  6. Rich as Buck - $1,000,000 Family Savings

    $1,000,000 saved: checking limit $2,000,000, no perk.

  7. Final Tier - $2,000,000 Family Savings

    $2,000,000 saved: no perk, but $200,000 interest comes back. The last two goals are optional.

  3. Go to Room 10
  4. Take the pills from Vicki

    Pay Vicki $50 for the pills.

  5. Return to Jason with the pills

    Jason spots that they are ordinary Zombix, not painkillers.

  6. Return to Vicki's room

    Lucia wrestles Vicki, who agrees to find someone who sells the real thing.

  7. Get in Vicki's car / Drive to town / Go to Delights

    Drive to the Delights club in Port Gellhorn, where Vicki works.

  8. Wait for Vicki / Follow Frankie

    Her boss Frankie Delight hands over her pay.

  9. Follow Vicki / Get in Vicki's car
  10. Go to Dunk's trailer

    Dunk, her dealer, is not at his trailer.

  11. Go to the boatyard / Pull up next to Dunk's friends

    His friends at the boatyard say he is at the car wash.

  12. Go to the car wash
  13. Confront the Kolts / Open the shutter door

    The Kolts have Dunk cornered; he escapes under the shutter. Choose Defuse twice for professional reputation.

  14. Approach Dunk
  15. Get in Vicki's car / Go to Dunk's trailer

    Drive Dunk home. He is out of painkillers but knows a supplier.

Either
From
Papa Audacity
  1. How it starts

    After Quit Your Job, you get five stunt jumps to do on the AudaCity bike; two more follow.

  2. Dalton Island Statue

    Dalton Island statue: no road reaches the island, so take the ferry or a boat.

  3. Leonida Power and Light

    Leonida Power and Light: ride north to the dirt ramp over the river. Failing and resetting can despawn the bike.

  4. Ocean Beach Parking

    Ocean Beach parking: the jump is on the roof; a lift is just inside the entrance.

  5. St. Vitus Medical Center

    St. Vitus Medical Center: also on a car park roof, with a lift by the road.

  6. Mastadon Sand Mill

    Mastadon Sand Mill: a building site where workers report trespassers, so be quick.

  7. Downtown

    Downtown: take the lift in the marked room to the rooftop and wait for instructions.

  8. VCIA

    VCIA: on the west side, where the engineer has a set of jumps ready.

  1. How it starts

    Agree to the pool on the hotel balcony to get Pool Day; Eddie meets you at the bar and texts a few days later.

  2. Attend Eddie Acosta's Party

    The party is marked in the middle of Vice City. Either character, but go alone.

  3. Meet Eddie Acosta at the Elevator

    He rides the lift up with you, then locks you out on the roof: it is a crypto scam.

  4. Ending 1: Pay $50,000 and get scammed

    Pay $50,000 and all you get is a worthless NFT picture.

  5. Ending 2: Don't pay $50,000

    Refuse (or shoot at him; the door is bulletproof). Ride the bike over the solar panels at full speed to jump to the next roof and take its lift.

Banks, jewelry stores and other big scores by area, best payout first: how to do each one, what to bring, and the vault, safe or door code. Then every code on the companion map.

Rules that save you money

  1. HighPocket cash caps at $20,000 per character and is lost on Busted/Wasted; bank it at an ATM into BuckMe right after escaping.gtabase.comgames.gg
  2. MediumGetting busted or killed also costs unowned weapons, a small BuckMe fee and most likely any stash bags you carry.gtabase.com
  3. HighBank, Payday Loans and some stash cash is marked bills: unspendable until fenced, needs the Ch3 Dye Pack Jammer or dye packs can burst.powerpyx.commeowdb.comxboxplay.games
  4. HighHeat by target: stores 1-2 stars, jewelry/pawn higher, vault banks an instant 4 stars. A red heat zone lingers after stars clear.games.ggpowerpyx.comvideogameschronicle.com
  5. HighCops remember outfit, car, visible weapons, your partner and CCTV. Mask up, swap clothes/car, respray, or split Jason and Lucia.gtabase.comgames.gg
  6. HighOn-site CCTV (camera icon) can be wiped at the recorder; cloud CCTV (cloud icon) cannot, so shoot the camera instead.meowdb.comgtabase.com
  7. MediumAlarms call police instantly; cut them first at the white security panel in the back office for a quiet job.meowdb.comxboxplay.games
  8. HighFree-roam store/bank safe codes are random per save; threaten staff and pick 'Safe Code?' or read sticky notes and PCs.beebom.comgames.ggxboxplay.games
  9. HighNo code? Use Break Open on small safes or explosives on big ones; explosives damage part of the loot.games.ggmeowdb.com
  10. MediumRobbed spots close or empty for a while; stores reopen and gang sites restock. Hitting early pays less. No exact timer published.games.ggmeowdb.compowerpyx.com
  11. MediumBest fences: Yasmani (Little Cuba) for jewelry and marked bills, Tyrone (La Perle) for drugs. Brian/Donnie pay very little.beebom.comgames.gg
  12. MediumGarage drop-offs or handing bags to your partner are convenient but the fence takes a bigger cut.games.ggmeowdb.com
  13. HighVaults open only while a security van guard carries cash in; tail the van or buy a $10k tip from Yasmani after 2 Payday jobs.powerpyx.comgames.gg
  14. HighA job only counts as done once every objective is looted: drawer+safe (small bank), plus vault (large), back-room safe (smash 'n' grab).powerpyx.compowerpyx.com
  15. LowDon't grind cash before the end of Chapter 1: the story wipes your money then, though early robberies still count for trophies.keengamer.com

How to rob a jewelry store

  1. Unlocks after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Find stores under Map > Robberies > Smash 'n' Grabs.
  2. Smash every case and pick up what drops: breaking glass alone does not collect the loot.
  3. Always clear the back room safe too, or the store does not count as done.
  4. Safe codes are random outside the story jobs: threaten a clerk and ask for the code, look for a note on desks, or search a downed guard.
  5. No code? A sticky bomb opens the safe, but it is loud.
  6. Quiet entry: the snap gun from Yasmani's jobs opens back doors silently (choose Use Snap Gun instead of Break Open).
  7. Bring body armor if it may go loud, sticky bombs for safes, and a car with a trunk for guns, loot and a spare outfit.
  8. Covgari, Blanc & Giroux and Royal Jewelry are the Retail Therapy partner chain: medium security, best take, and your wanted level carries between the three stops.
  9. Robbing as Jason and Lucia together raises their relationship; go solo to avoid it.
  10. Change clothes or use Pay 'n' Spray to shake recognition, and bank cash at an ATM: dying or arrest loses what you carry.
  11. Fence with Yasmani in Little Cuba for the best rate; Brian and Donnie pay little; Duncan in Port Gellhorn pays a bit more after Slam Dunk.
  12. Completion needs 34 of 35 Smash 'n' Grabs (20 jewelry stores and 15 pawn shops) and $100,000 of fenced jewelry. Bright green map icons are done.

Source: GAMES.GG jewelry store guide (updated 26 Nov 2026). Single source, so treat take ranges as a guide; Vice-Dale County is Miami-Dade.

Weapons and loadout

Which guns to grab first, how sharing works, and the combat tricks the videos keep repeating. Every chapter page also has a table of the unique weapons in its area.

How weapons work

High priority

Blue = owned (bought at Ammu-Nation): kept for good, can be modded, recovered from your trunk or a weapon locker. Gold = unique: kept for good even if dropped, generally no mods. White = borrowed pickup: lost if you die, drop it, get busted or reload; storing it in your trunk keeps it for now but never makes it owned (Soulgrot).

Watch video
High priority

A basic vest is $250 from the Ammu-Nation equipment menu: a blue bar over your health that soaks bullets and explosions (not animal bites) and does not regenerate. Keep spares in your trunk.

Watch video
High priorityChapter 2

JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb share weapons once either picks one up, but not attachments or ammo (Truds). Owned and unique guns can be taken back free from the green weapon locker in Gellhorn Outfitters and other gun stores.

How to find it: next to Gellhorn Outfitters in Port GellhornReal lifePanama City and the Panhandle61 of 97 GTADB landmark matches here are in Panama City..

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Dropped enemy guns can't be kept; only unique variants (yellow icon) stay with you, and they unlock for both characters. IGN counts 127 (plus two in the Ultimate Edition).
  • Longarms stay on your back until you store them in the locker or the trunk.
Watch videoMapIGN: How to keep weapons ↗IGN: Unique weapon variants ↗IGN: Put away and store weapons ↗
High priority

Silenced guns keep gangs and police unaware during illegal operations, and a quiet, low-casualty clear moves your profile toward Professional. Shoot the yellow focus marks (or legs with a shotgun) to incapacitate.

Watch video
Medium priority

Sticky bombs open the big safes, and so do grenades, which you can already buy in Chapter 2 (sticky bombs reach the gun shop in Chapter 3). Hold RB while aiming to throw the equipped explosive; set Projectile arc to Always on in Settings > UI. C4 can be detonated mid-air with D-pad right.

More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Plant Sticky Bombs through the safe's prompt; a thrown one won't open it. Ammu-Nation sells them for $185 each after Credit Check. Chuck's Tackle & Shot, east of Jason's house, is the nearest shop.
Watch videoIGN: Sticky Bombs ↗
Low priority

Turn off weapon sway (it helps the range challenges and the whole game). D-pad left while aiming swaps shoulders. Change both characters' loadouts from the weapon wheel inside a car; the trunk is only for armour and stored items.

Watch video
Low priority

Open any trunk from the D-pad left > Vehicle menu, even while driving; police cars usually carry a vest and heavy guns.

Watch video
Low priority

When picking up a gun that replaces one in your hand, open the weapon wheel to compare the two.

Watch video
Medium priority

Police cars, police pickups and ambulances can be looted for weapons (stun guns, rifles, shotguns), body armour, healing items and ammo, sometimes grenades: a quick fix when a robbery goes wrong.

Watch video
Medium priority

Focus slows time but drains fast; switching characters lets you use the other one's Focus meter (the purple eye, top left), so as a duo you can stay in Focus almost all fight. LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb also fits into tighter spaces than JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb for cover and hiding.

Watch video

All unique variants: how the checklist works

High priority

IGN counts 127 unique weapon variants (yellow gun icon in the world, yellow name in menus). Picking one up unlocks it for both JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb, and you can take it out again at any weapon locker. They cannot be modified. The lists below name 123 of them; 14 have no known location yet.

IGN: Unique Weapon Variants ↗
Medium priority

One list counts 23 sold at specific gun shops, 37 lying in the world (wrecks, bunkers, motel rooms, the seabed) and 29 as the key valuable of an illegal operation; a few are mission rewards.

Low priority

Low Point Nipper .38, Caminos Signature K17, DWNPLY's K17, EJ's K17, Dumpster K17 MCD, BrianCharacterBrian HederPlayed by Stephen RootStephen Root on IMDb's 1922, RaulCharacterRaul BautistaPlayed by Manny PerezManny Perez on IMDb's 1922, Convict Kalinga .50, Bae-Lux's W-10, RoxyFirst appearance · CharacterRoxy Rashad (Real Dimez)Played by Krissy CelessKrissy Celess on IMDb's W-10, TyroneCharacterTyrone RussoPlayed by Taylor NovakTaylor Novak on IMDb's W-10, Furry DW-9, Raul's CQB 556, Raul's Heist 556. Several carry a character's name (Raul, Brian, Roxy), so they may be story or mission rewards; that is our guess, not a sourced fact.

StealthStealth tips
  • Go at night: it is easier to stay unseen (Jay Dunna).
  • Crouch along the south side of the 2nd floor and use Focus to see who is looking; two gang members need taking down quietly, the second from the side path by the grow operation (Its Shatter).
  • Take guards from behind: choke them out, or pistol-whip with a suppressed pistol out (Jay Dunna).
  • If the alarm goes up, pull them through the choke point north of the safe room and drop them with knee and elbow shots (Its Shatter).
  • Leave by dropping through the broken floors; the police arrive after the noise (Jay Dunna).

Staying unseen

High priority

Enemies spot you by line of sight (distance, crouching, cover) and by noise. Running, gunshots and engines show as white rings around your minimap arrow; crouch-walking makes none (GhillieMaster, Caspahz).

Watch video
High priority

White arrow on black: nobody is after you. A white circle around it: police are actively pursuing. Grey with a black centre: you are concealed, which happens crouched in thick bushes, ducked down in a car, or in cover (GhillieMaster).

Watch video
High priority

Suppressed shots go unnoticed unless someone is right beside you or is hit; police can fail to hear them from about 20 feet. Unsuppressed fire re-centres the police search circle on you, suppressed fire leaves it at your last known spot. They cost close to $1,000 per gun; the two types work much the same (GhillieMaster).

Watch video
High priority

Buy one in the mod section of any gun store for each weapon you use. Customize on the weapon wheel takes a suppressor off or puts it back, including on uniques that come with one. Suppressed guns keep other enemies and the police from showing up (Caspahz, JorRaptor).

Watch video
High priority

Footsteps are silent while crouched (jayvee). Your minimap icon shows when you are making noise and giving enemies a chance to notice (Caspahz). Game8 suggests turning off the 'Stand and Sprint' setting so sprinting does not stand you up mid-stealth.

Watch video
High priority

Scope enemies to mark them over their heads (Essential Tips I Wish I Knew Sooner). In Focus, the yellow marks (knees, elbows) are non-lethal hits that keep a Professional profile (JorRaptor, PC Gamer).

Watch video
Medium priority

Choke people out or pistol-whip them instead of killing: no witnesses, and no Psycho profile penalty (jayvee, Jay Dunna). Sneak attacks, disabling alarms and destroying cameras all count toward Professional (Unknown Player).

Watch video
Medium priorityChapter 3

Shoot cameras with a silenced pistol before going in (Sparkz GTA). Back doors let you subdue staff, destroy footage and disable alarms (PC Gamer); the Snap Gun from Chapter 3 opens locks without tripping alarms (jayvee).

Medium priority

Leave by the back or over fences so the police outside never get your description (Sparkz GTA). A mask, a getaway car parked close by and going at night all help (jayvee, Jay Dunna). With a partner along, they must not get caught either, or the stealth is ruined (JorRaptor).

High priority

Two sidearms, two longarms, a melee weapon, an in-hand item and explosives. Swapping to a sidearm is faster than reloading. Your personal vehicle's trunk holds the rest, so you can rebuild the loadout for each job; only personal vehicles reliably keep it (GamesRadar, Game8, grandtheft.gg).

Stats and skills

Strength (max health), Cardio (stamina) and Focus (slow-motion time), separate for JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb, and the quests that raise their limits for good.

Training

High priority

Strength (health), Cardio (stamina) and Focus are separate for each character. Strength and Cardio drop if you stop training, skip meals or sleep; permanent boosts are kept on top. Strength: any three of the four home-gym exercises max the day's gain; Cardio: punching bag (in the shed under JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's house), running, cycling, each with a daily cap, so rotate; a protein shake from the fridge cuts recovery time. Focus: fishing (no daily cap seen) or the ranges. Being fed and rested helps. Working out with your partner trains both.

More detail (3)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Fitness is tracked per character, unless Jason and Lucia work out at a gym together.
  • Strength and Cardio drop if you skip workouts, so watch the Fitness tracker. Use Jason's home equipment or one of the nine gyms.
  • Focus has no workout window, and every Focus gain is permanent: fishing and petting animals also add to it.
Watch videoIGN: Fitness and workouts ↗IGN: Making Gainz ↗
High priority

Any three sets complete the day's workout and fill a third of the level circle. Then sleep 24 hours. Three workouts make one level, and there are four levels, so 12 workouts max it out. Rep quality doesn't matter, only finishing the set. Bring your partner: you both level up together, and the partner gets in free on your guest pass. Chapter 3 is the easiest, because Dynamics Fitness is about 15 seconds from the apartment (Griff Griffin, 26 Nov).

Where in LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach.: Dynamics Fitness, Vice CityReal lifeMiami600 of 641 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.; any of the nine gyms, or JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb's home weights

More detail (9)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Settings > Accessibility: set Tap assist to Hold and Hold assist to x4, so holding the button does the tapping.
  • Settings > Gameplay > Simplified Mini Games: sets can no longer fail, and the triggers are just on or off.
  • Protein bars (on gym counters and in vending machines) speed recovery and clear the orange 'Hungry' status, which cuts your gains. One bar is usually enough.
  • Give your partner a protein bar for one heart, or two with a show of affection; a gym date adds half a heart. The video reached the top relationship level over the 12 days.
  • If Stamina runs out mid-set, the set fails: drink from the gym water fountain to refill Stamina and Focus.
  • Cardio: about 15 seconds on the punching bag is the fastest step; running around the world counts too. Cardio doesn't undo Strength, because they are separate meters.
  • Lucia works exactly the same as Jason. The video thinks max Strength makes one-punch knockouts easier, but that's unconfirmed.
  • The deadlift bar could not be used before patch 01.002.002 (23 November); update if it will not work.
  • Go to the gym with both characters: the one you are not playing trains by themselves and it still counts.

Medium priority

Run on a beach until stamina is near 10%, then swim underwater until your breath is near 10% (trains lung capacity), and repeat. Once the couple's gym is unlocked, train there: the partner copies your exercise, so both characters gain Strength at once (Musty Sky).

Low priority

Sub-skills that level with use: walk around crouched for 10-15 minutes for Stealth; hold wheelies on a motorcycle for Driving. Caffeine and healthy food push you above your max for a while. Single source. Caspahz: the fastest Focus experience is fishing with the auto-reel option turned on in settings; throwing drink waste into a bin from a distance also gives a little.

Medium priority

Store food gives a health buff, Zombix heals, a vape refills and boosts Focus, coffee and tea refill Focus, a safe-house shower buffs it. Adrenaline (found, or free from ambulances) fully refills health, stamina and Focus when you are nearly down.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Zombix costs $15 at convenience stores and is often free in first aid cabinets (white with a green label), red pouches and bathrooms. Adrenaline can't be bought; you can carry three per character.
  • Zombix only heals up to the white line on the health bar. The Vice City Hospital pharmacy in Rockridge has at least two free Zombix; apples are free in many lobbies and kitchens.

Cars worth keeping

Registering, the standout cars the videos keep returning to, and where to find them. Registered cars can be called with Scooter Bros.

Keeping cars

High priorityChapter 2

MosesCharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb (Chapter 2) registers untracked cars: the first one is free. From early Chapter 3 Pay 'n' Spray also takes cars with standard trackers. Until you can register, park cars in your spots or garages. Most of these cars respawn if you miss or wreck them. Moses' garage holds two cars, and after each delivery he is busy for about two real minutes (his map icon shows it). Scooter Bros premium is a one-time $12,500. You can register only as many cars as you have garage spaces. An unregistered car, and anything stashed in it, is lost if it is destroyed, you are busted or you reload (GosuNoob).

Criminal profile

How violent each character's play has been. It changes how police treat you and, at the far end, the story.

The tiers

High priorityChapter 1

Professional (start) and Hardened: incapacitating shots and stealth takedowns refill Focus, you can surrender at low wanted levels, police mostly use tasers. Violent (purple icon): headshots refill Focus. Psycho (grey): no surrender, more lethal police. You can move between these four. Trojan claims Professional is needed for the best endings (single source).

Watch video
High priority

Keep killing civilians and police after the many warnings (the Psycho icon cracks) and you become Irredeemable: it cannot be changed on that save and affects the story and endings. Save before going wild.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • You get two warnings (the emoji cracks) before Irredeemable. After that, only an earlier save undoes it.
  • Professional and Hardened earn permanent Focus from non-lethal takedowns and small good deeds; Violent and Psycho earn it only from headshots. Each character's profile and the relationship decide the ending.

Money glitches

One master guide to every money glitch in the saved videos, step by step, with where the creators disagree. Exploits: they may be patched.

Before you startGlitches are exploits: the videos were made between 23 and 26 November 2026, one says it 'works after today's patch', and any update can break them. Make a manual save first. Everything below is cross-checked across the videos; where they disagree the guide says so.

High priority

Patch 01.002.002 (23 November) fixed: crashes, weather stuck for long periods, autosaves not saving, story and mission-unlock phone calls not arriving, a Wanted level that could not be lost, the gym deadlift bar, and partners not handing over bags to sell to fences (IGN).

The older two-van loop from 23-24 Nov still works as the base if the newer tricks fail. Video dates: Mile High 28 and PuRe GhOsTT 26 Nov; Preacher Mundo, Bubs, B Man, Musty Sky, Obese Giraffe 25 Nov; GriMzvX, Cbass, Jay Dunna 24 Nov.

Newest (27 Nov): the stash bag drop glitch

High priority

Two videos from 27 November show a stash bag gaining value every time you drop it and pick it up again without moving. Glitches like this are usually patched fast, and neither video says which patch it was tested on.

Watch video
Medium priority

One stash bag with loot in it: narcotics or marked bills work (one video also says jewelry). A full bag (about $10,800) grows fastest.

Watch video
High priority

Crouch and wait until fully crouched. Open the item wheel (L1/LB), go to the stash bag and hold Circle/B to drop it. Do not move: only turn the camera to look at the bag, then press Triangle/Y a few times to pick it up. Repeat.

Newest: one stash bag past its cap (25-26 Nov videos)Five videos (Bubs, B Man, PuRe GhOsTT, Mile High 28, Preacher Mundo) show the same trick with small differences; the steps below are what they agree on.

High priority

1) Grab one brick into a bag (one brick, $1,200 in Chapter 3) and stow it in your vehicle: this is the 'small' bag. 2) Fill a second bag from the vans to about $6,000 (Preacher Mundo tops it up to the $9,600 cap) and stow it too. 3) Set up the four vans and swap characters so the bricks respawn. 4) Take the BIG bag out first (it has to be the one on your shoulder), then the small one. 5) Take bricks only from the LEFT side of each van, spamming the pick-up button (Triangle/Y). 6) Swap characters, repeat. It worked when the big bag climbs past the cap (about $9,600-10,800); creators show $100,000-120,000 in one bag.

Watch video
Medium priority

PuRe GhOsTT, Mile High 28 and Preacher Mundo: left side only, the right side 'kills' the glitch. Bubs words it as 'only the paired bricks, the single one last', and B Man does the same into his Thrax trunk. Mile High says keep the second bag at $6,000 max; Preacher Mundo fills it to the cap first. PuRe GhOsTT found it random at first and only got it working after several tries.

Watch video
Medium priority

If the small bag picks up bricks, drop it in a spare 'dummy' van and make a new one-brick bag (Preacher Mundo, PuRe GhOsTT). If your bags reappear in the van after a swap, just take the big one out first again (Mile High 28). If the moved vans vanish, your own vehicle is parked too close to them (Preacher Mundo, PuRe GhOsTT).

Watch video
Medium priority

A huge single bag is one huge pending payment: it only lands when the whole amount fits in your bank (B Man).

Watch video

Newest: four vans (24-26 Nov videos)The upgrade every video from 24 November on uses. Why it works (Cbass, B Man): the last vehicle each character touched does not despawn, so moving each original van with a different character leaves two extra vans when the originals respawn.

Medium priority

The teddy-bear-van warehouse near HamletReal lifeHomestead and Florida City39 of 57 GTADB landmark matches here are in Homestead. still restocks after the patch in one video: register a 10-bag van first (MosesCharacterMoses "Mo" WatkinsPlayed by Aaron MortonAaron Morton on IMDb in Chapter 2, later any Pay 'n' Spray), wait until Chapter 2, and do not drive or steal the teddy-bear vans themselves. A second video claims about $316,800 an hour with a save-and-reload trick at the 10-bag limit.

Watch video
High priority

1) Bring both characters to the warehouse. 2) As one character, move the inside van off its spot; as the other, move the outside van. 3) Hold right on the D-pad and choose Split up (Triangle/Y) so one character leaves. 4) Wait 2-3 minutes until you can switch to them, switch, then switch straight back. 5) Four vans now hold bricks; loot them, repeat step 4 for a refill (B Man, Musty Sky, Bubs, Obese Giraffe, Jay Dunna, GriMzvX). Keep your own car away from the vans' spots or they will not respawn (PuRe GhOsTT, Preacher Mundo).

Watch video
Medium priority

Jay Dunna backs both vans in rear-first, just past the painted lines; B Man parks them side by side with the backs facing the door; Musty Sky moves the inside van a little right and parks the outside one inside the garage, turning left; Obese Giraffe drives both a short way out of the warehouse; GriMzvX moves the inside van aside and parks the outside van inside on the opposite side. Common ground: get each van off its spawn spot, using a different character for each, and keep the back doors reachable.

Watch video

Bubs and Obese Giraffe loot both vans first, then move them; Musty Sky says do not loot before the setup. Both orders are shown working, so it does not seem to matter.

Musty Sky: close the rear doors before moving each van and again after every looting run; an open door or a broken panel makes the moved van despawn. No other video mentions it, but it costs nothing.

Car mods: what to buy

High priority

There are 14 mod shops (Map index > Vehicles > Mod Shops). Drive the car you want to build: the shop whose icon shows a small blue wrench specialises in it and has the exclusive Pro Builds, paints and wraps. Any shop does repairs and the shared parts (outputlag).

More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Always start at your car's specialist shop: the blue wrench shows on the map icon and minimap while you sit in the car, and a WAiNK scan says which specialist it is (for example 'Specialist: Luxury'). Specialists carry exclusive performance parts (KhrazeGaming).
Watch videoMap
High priority

Register the car before buying expensive mods, so you don't lose them. A damaged car must be repaired before the shop lets you mod it. Kits are often bank-only, so keep money in BuckMe.

High priority

Full Engine first (Stage 1 is $900 on the Ganado), then Transmission and Intakes, then Boost: older cars get nitrous, modern ones a turbo or supercharger. Watch the stat bars: some parts trade one stat for another.

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • A level-3 Full Kit gives the same stats as buying every Performance part (engine, induction, transmission, boost) yourself, minus the wheels. The kit is just convenience (KhrazeGaming).
  • Each shop's kits follow its theme: Euroform's maxes speed, acceleration and asphalt handling but cuts off-road handling hard.
Watch videoMap
Medium priority

Match tyres to the job: off-road tyres for grass and dirt, track slicks for asphalt only (they spin out on a verge). Raise the suspension for off-road, lower it for the road.

How to find it: next to Wasteland Off-Road in Port GellhornReal lifePanama City and the Panhandle61 of 97 GTADB landmark matches here are in Panama City..

More detail (2)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • After performance parts, the wheel kit matters most. Euroform's is a track setup (best asphalt handling). Stockyard, Capri and Whisler offer drag setups: more top speed, less grip. A drag-stance muscle car reached 9.7 speed and won the Port Gellhorn raceway gold challenge in one run (KhrazeGaming).
  • Seven tyre styles: Track (grip), Drag (straight-line speed), Rally (the best all-rounder: much better off-road without losing much speed), Vintage (muscle cars that leave the road), Performance and Sport (no stat difference found), plus Off-road; Wasteland adds a Paddle tyre for water. Whisler has most of them.
Watch videoMap
Medium priority

Preset builds per car; specialist shops carry the best. Examples: the Ganado Retro Build (free with the Ultimate Edition at Coastal Auto Care), and the Western '72 Cliffhanger's Off-Road builds at $2,055 / $7,445 / $13,305 (gtaboss).

Medium priority

The H-AT rocket launcher does the most damage (9.6). The Deever Tech GLR40 grenade launcher (6 rounds) is free in the Sunrise Motel garage in TequestaReal lifeMiami (named after the Tequesta people of the Miami River)52 of 52 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.; the Boomer launcher is by the escape boat in Sunset.

MapIGN: Launchers ↗

Gun mods worth buying

High priority

The best upgrade in the game (GhillieMaster): nearby people and police barely hear you, and the police search circle stays on your last seen spot. It's the priciest attachment, about $720-1,000 per gun; the cheaper of the two models does the same job. You can take it off or put it back from the weapon wheel anywhere.

Watch videoMap
High priority

The best budget buy, since it cuts reloads in long fights. One guide prices the Duke 556's at about $130. IGN's first Mediator magazine upgrade costs $55.

Map
Medium priority

Add a scope if you fight across open ground. Twelve attachment types change damage, accuracy, handling (weight, which drains Stamina), range and magazine. Swapping or removing attachments you own is free at any Ammu-Nation weapon vendor (IGN).

How to find it: next to Little Gems Jewellery in RockridgeReal lifeMiami67 of 67 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.. Real-world counterpart (GTADB): 210 SW 22nd Ave, Miami, FL 33135, USA.

MapIGN: Weapons and attachments ↗
Medium priority

Unique (gold) weapons come with a fixed set of mods and can't be customised. Dropped enemy guns (white) can't be kept. Owned (blue) store guns take all attachments and wraps. Mods and ammo aren't shared between JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb and LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb.

Hairstyle catalog

Every salon and barber, where it is, and each style it sells, one by one, with its price and who it is for. Standard styles first, then shop by shop. Each row opens the video at that style.

How hairstyles work

High priority

Every salon and barber sells the same standard styles. Each shop also has its own signature styles (up to 8 per character), and some add creative styles: patterned buzz cuts and coloured designs. So where you go decides what you can get.

Watch video
Medium priority

Barbers do men's cuts and facial hair. Beauty salons also do LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb's makeup and nails. Unisex salons serve both characters. Hair colour is chosen separately from the cut.

Medium priority

Styling magazines hidden around LeonidaReal lifeFlorida1 of 7 GTADB landmark matches here are in Pensacola Beach. unlock extra hairstyles, makeup and tattoos at any shop. They are on the 'Hairstyles and outfits' page (LuciaCharacterLucia CaminosPlayed by Manni L. PerezManni L. Perez on IMDb: hidden hairstyles, JasonCharacterJason DuvalPlayed by Dylan RourkeDylan Rourke on IMDb: hidden hairstyles, Hidden tattoos) and on the 'Magazines and locations' page.

Low priority

A style you bought is not free to re-apply: changing back means paying again (PowerPyx).

Low priority

The matching catalog for clothes is the 'Clothing directory' page (every store, by area and by type), with the 'Clothing brands' page beside it.

Low priority

One section per shop: first the shop and where it is, then each style it sells. Names and prices were read from the on-screen text of Mr Lawrence's video, sampled every 4 seconds, so a few styles are missing and a price can be off. The video link on each row opens at that style.

Robbery trucks and getaway bikes

The armoured Gunrunner Kamacho, what to fit on it, backup trucks and the Sanchez getaway bike (Caspahz's video, with what this guide already had).

Why a truck instead of a supercar

Medium priority

Supercars are fast, but a couple of hits into a wall and the engine is done. The armoured trucks below take damage for minutes, smash roadblocks and can tow supercars (with or without people inside), police cars, the armoured cash vans and even a tow truck that is towing something (one video).

StealthStealth tips
  • Stay crouched the whole way.
  • Use Focus for the second guard of each pair.
High priority

Bring a suppressed weapon. Enter through the hole in the fence at the south-west corner, wait for the two guards to swap spots, crouch and take the first. Work up to the truck (one guard behind it), then the two at the front gate: one shot, Focus for the second.

Watch video
High priority

Two guards inside the first door (KZ-59 rifle, H&L Mediator and Laird 350 on the racks). Shooting the outside door buttons draws the rest out one by one; take them from behind the railing (aim at the yellow weak points to stay Professional). Behind the red door: two more, then the GRX 5.56 carbine, frag grenades, sticky bombs and body armour. Hold the washroom as cover while more come in. The safe code is on the laptop in the next room: 9256 in this video (another video saw the same; it may differ for you). A luxury watch is on that table; over $10,000 in all.

Medium priority

One guard outside the door, one behind the crates, one working on the truck and two by the garage door: from a distance shoot the buttons to open it and take the left and right guards. No police, no wanted level: drive the Kamacho out.

It comes with a winch (rip ATMs out, tow vehicles from the front or back), a stage 4 engine, better speed, acceleration and off-road handling than the normal Kamacho, and much more strength from its front and rear bumpers.

Max the induction (it has none) and the transmission (it comes at level 1), add nitrous for police escapes, leave the tyres. Keep the bumpers: they are where its strength comes from.

High priority

Park the bike behind the target. After the robbery ride out between the roadblocks instead of through them, with the GPS set to one of your garages. Keep a 10-slot van inside: stash the loot in its trunk, change outfit while you are under cover, and the wanted level clears.

Before you start: the rules

High priority

The timer starts when you press the button at the Badger R&D Tower and does not reset between stations. Sleeping, waiting and fast travel all move the clock on. A Ryde Me taxi is fine as long as you do not fast travel in it.

More detail (1)In our words, from IGN's walkthrough and the credited videos.
  • Our suggestion: start in the morning with a fast car or a helicopter ready, since the route crosses the whole map from Key Lento to Port Gellhorn and the final stop only works from 19:00 to 06:00.
Watch video
High priority

Use exactly one button or lever at each station, in the order 1 to 12. The wrong switch or an out-of-order station resets the puzzle; go back to the tower to restart. After starting, do NOT press the tower button or touch its lever again.

Watch video
Low priority

The big stencil letters on the 12 stations spell 'LifeIsPassingMeBy', Vice CityReal lifeMiami600 of 641 GTADB landmark matches here are in Miami.'s PC cheat. If you lose track, the letter tells you which station you are at.

How sure each match is

Medium priority

Reading the in-game map

What the pins, colours, letters and dark areas on the pause-menu map mean, from photos of the real map and what guide sites agree on. Our companion map now uses the same look: outlined names, county names when zoomed out and the same pin shape and colours.

Pin coloursSeen on the real map; where the game does not spell out a meaning it is our reading of the photos.

High priority

The letters are the contact's initials (K, R, TR, YJ, W and Ay are on the photos). A small J or L in the corner shows which character the mission is for.

High priorityChapter 3

A '?' until you have met them (The Unknown Stuntman starts this way), then an icon such as a car, a pill or a seated figure.

Medium priority

A mask or a gang tag (PTT, M7, KK). A small '?' in the corner seems to mean not scouted yet and a tick means done (our reading).

Medium priority

A note icon for messages and tips; the house is your safehouse.

Medium priority

Shirt for clothes, scissors for barbers and salons, a pistol for gun shops, a dumbbell for gyms and headphones (probably music stores). A shop can stay hidden until you have found it.

Low priority

They look like places that buy from you (fences and pawn shops); our reading of the icon.

Low priority

A mission that cannot be started right now, for example one for the other character (our reading: YJ and Ay are greyed on the photos).

Low priority

Your current destination and the route to it.

  22. 10 Things I Wish I Knew When I Started (Paul Tassi) 18:26

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise, step 5: Gear Up

    Ten habits from 140 hours of play that are worth picking up while you gear up in Chapter 1.

    How to do it

    1. Start each day with a routine: sleep (or you lose stamina), eat, then work out now and then; skipping workouts loses fitness.
    2. Carry a silenced pistol as your everyday weapon: you die far less than going in loud.
    3. Use a street bike for getting around; keep trucks for barricades and supercars for later.
    4. Rampages build your criminal profile: expect to die a lot and pay for it later.
    5. On the phone, press Square for missed notifications: missed calls and texts often start the next mission.
    6. Assign a spare outfit to a car you own from your closet, then change out of sight to lose heat.
    7. Dropping a long gun to clear the 'armed' status is fine: you do not lose weapons you own.
    8. Carry little cash (he keeps under about $1,000) and bank the rest at an ATM (BuckMe has an ATM finder): you die easily early on, and BuckMe pays for almost everything.
    9. Stop for world events that show subtitles: they are unique and can lead somewhere.

    Key moments

    1. 1:13 Morning routine and fitness
    2. 3:15 Fitness tiers
    3. 4:12 Silenced pistol
    4. 6:21 Street bikes
    5. 8:53 Criminal profile
    6. 10:36 Missed notifications
    7. 11:45 Spare outfits and heat
    8. 13:07 Dropping long guns
    9. 14:26 Carry little cash
    10. 15:28 World events with subtitles

    Single source (Paul Tassi). Captions were made with local speech-to-text, so a few words may be misheard.

  23. Tips I Wish I Knew Earlier: Settings, Workouts, Clean Store Robberies (JorRaptor) 9:16

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise, step 5: Gear Up

    Early habits for Chapter 1: settings, a daily workout routine, what to buy at the gun shop, quiet store robberies, losing the police and an early unique SMG.

    How to do it

    1. Wear a bandana and keep spare outfits with caps and sunglasses in your trunk.
    2. Park a little way from the store so the police are less likely to spot your car.
    3. Wait for any customer to leave, then threaten the clerk a few times; he finds they are then too scared to call the cops.
    4. In the staff area, destroy the camera footage, disable the alarm and check for a safe.
    5. If the cops get your description, swap headwear, glasses and mask, or change outfit at the trunk.
    6. Put the cash in your home stash: you lose what you carry if you die or are arrested.

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 Settings: push to run, turn on the compass
    2. 0:37 Daily workout routine
    3. 1:45 Gun shop: body armor, silencer, bandana
    4. 2:36 Rob a store without the police
    5. 3:45 Losing the police
    6. 5:33 Early unique weapons at illegal operations
    7. 7:04 Watch your criminal profile
    8. 8:09 Hidden spot: unique SMG and $10,000

    Partly overlaps Paul Tassi's video at this step and 'Essential Tips I Wish I Knew Sooner'. The hidden spot is the Crabshack outpost, and his codes (CLEAVES, 0072, 0212) match the guide's step. Conflicting: he says a body armor vest that breaks must be bought again, but the guide's Gear Up step says putting it back on repairs it. Single source: his claim that the criminal profile changes the story and the endings. He does not name the golden AK warehouse or the second illegal operation with a sniper. He also says illegal operations restock after a cooldown, with less loot. Saving and reloading repairs your car for free, and stolen weapons are lost but narcotics stay in the trunk.

    How to do it

    1. Make an extra save before you go near the base.
    2. Take the highway exit on the east side of Mile Zero Air Station and turn right.
    3. Drive up the ramp there to jump the fence.
    4. Jets stand in a row; the tanks are parked elsewhere on the base, with APCs round the corner.
    5. Expect a wanted level. Military vehicles have permanent trackers, so you cannot keep them.

  36. Money glitch: Store Robbery Reset with a Mission Restart (Neon, 19 Nov) 11:52

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise, step 18: Hey Arnold!

    He uses the opening cutscene of Meet Brian (this mission) to reopen stores near Jason's house that he had just robbed, so do it before you play the mission.

    How to do it

    1. Park at the gas station by the burger shop near Jason's house.
    2. Rob the burger shop (all three registers) and the store next door; a nearby liquor store can be added.
    3. Drive to a story mission that opens with a cutscene (he used Meet Brian).
    4. As soon as the cutscene starts, pause and choose Restart Mission.
    5. When the screen comes back from black, pause again and Quit Mission. Do both quickly: done slowly it failed.
    6. The robbed stores show as open again, so rob them again.

    Key moments

    1. 0:31 Setup: a mission with an opening cutscene
    2. 1:34 Rob the two stores
    3. 2:28 Pause, restart, quit
    4. 3:44 A longer route with a liquor store
    5. 6:00 A working run, done fast

    Single source, and he is not sure it works with every mission. Store names are as heard (a 'Marbles' burger shop; the liquor store is probably Three Sheets). Meet Brian is this mission's subtitle in the guide. Exploits like this may be patched.

  37. Fix Jason's House and Everything Before Lucia (Jay Dunna) 4:15

    The run-up to Coming Home in order: the house repairs Lucia likes, the hidden punching bag, then groceries, roses, a haircut, the necklace and her clothes.

    How to do it

    1. Put up the bedroom drywall, then fix the railing outside the door.
    2. Rebuild the stairs from the planks by the other staircase, then climb the ladder and fix the leaky roof.
    3. Paint the bedroom wall behind the dresser: push the stick all the way up, then all the way down.
    4. Take the punching bag from the corner of the shed and hang it outside. It is not marked, but Lucia likes it.
    5. Feed Dolores and sleep; Lucia calls when you wake up and there is time for every errand.
    6. Errands: groceries (into the trunk, then close it), roses ($25), the necklace with a haircut next door, the groceries home, then Lucia's clothes into the trunk.

  39. Money glitch: Stash Bags Respawn after Save and Load, Chapter 1 (MrBossFTW, 20 Nov) 9:52

    Where it fits: Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise, step 23: Clean Up After Donnie

    A Chapter 1 loot loop at the teddy-van warehouse, sold at Donnie's (he paid more than Brian), with the warning that cash is lost when Chapter 1 ends.

    How to do it

    1. Drive your own car to the unmarked warehouse among lakes on the South Vice-Dale County / Hamlet border.
    2. Loot the teddy van, the big stash bag of marked bills, the office register and the safe (a collectible card).
    3. Store the stash bags in your car's trunk.
    4. Save (he suggests a fresh slot), then load that save.
    5. Drive back: the loot has respawned and the bags are still in your trunk.
    6. Sell when the trunk is full. Before Chapter 1 ends, put $5,000 in Family Savings and spend the rest on things that carry over (weapons, clothes, tattoos).

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 The warehouse and what to loot
    2. 3:36 Save, load, loot again
    3. 6:05 Kingfisher stilt house stash also respawns
    4. 7:10 Sell to Brian or Donnie
    5. 7:53 Chapter 1 ending: what you keep

    Same warehouse as the Chapter 2 and 3 loop videos (near-duplicate of DPJ's save-and-load method). Business names on the site ('Apollo', 'Flying Teddies') are as heard. About $13,000 per run and the card value (up to $6,000) are his figures. Single source that the Kingfisher stilt house also respawns. Glitches may be patched.
