  75. Money glitch: Character Switch Respawn with a Registered Van (Xee Gaming, 20 Nov) 6:35

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 2: Paradise Lost, step 17: Coffee Break

    This method needs free switching between Jason and Lucia, which opens with this mission, plus a van you have registered at Moses.

    How to do it

    1. Register a van at Moses (choose Service, then Register, not Sell).
    2. Leave the other character far away, for example asleep at home, and take a taxi to the spot in South Vice-Dale County.
    3. Call your registered van there with the Scooter Bros app.
    4. Loot the van and the building, including the safe, and store it all in your van.
    5. Switch to the other character and back without moving: the loot is back.
    6. Repeat until the van is full, then drop the bags at Dunk's Trailer and wait for payment.

    Key moments

    1. 0:38 Needs switching and a registered van
    2. 1:23 Location in South Vice-Dale County
    3. 2:40 Loot into your van
    4. 4:20 Switch and switch back
    5. 5:41 Selling

    The $390 million in the title is not shown or explained in the transcript. The site is probably the same teddy-van warehouse as the other loop videos (near-duplicate of Musty Sky's switch method). Dunk's Trailer is heard as 'dunk straighter'. Glitches may be patched.

  76. Money glitch: Character Switch and Bridge Loop (Musty Sky, 21 Nov) 8:21

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 2: Paradise Lost, step 17: Coffee Break

    His fastest Chapter 2 method uses free switching, which opens with this mission; a slower drive-away version also works in Chapter 1.

    How to do it

    1. Go to the teddy-van warehouse on the east side of Hamlet.
    2. Pick up the bricks behind the teddy van, in the van down the hallway and in the locker, plus the cash.
    3. Put the bag in the white van there (it holds 10) and sit inside it, or the first bag can vanish.
    4. Walk about 10 metres away, switch to Lucia and straight back to Jason: the bricks are back.
    5. If the locker does not refill, drive the white van right, over the bridge, U-turn at the first traffic light and come back.
    6. Sell the full van to Brian or another buyer; the money arrives the next day.

    Key moments

    1. 1:09 The loot route
    2. 2:56 Switch to Lucia and back
    3. 5:21 The Chapter 1 version
    4. 6:38 Bridge U-turn reset (locker always refills)

    Near-duplicate of Xee Gaming's switch method and Silent Nine's drive-away reset at the same warehouse. About $3,600 of bricks per run and $1,200 from the locker are his figures. Glitches may be patched.

  78. Max Focus: Gun Range Loop and Fishing (SubscribeForTacos) 6:05

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 2: Paradise Lost, step 19: Level Focus to max at Rodgers Ranch

    A second source for the Port Gellhorn range loop, with how much each run gives and fishing as another way.

    How to do it

    1. Buy the $5 waiver in the Port Gellhorn gun range shop.
    2. Start the Market range on Beginner; a run takes about 10 seconds.
    3. Restart on repeat: each run gave +1% Focus, even without gold hits.
    4. Or fish: buy a small freshwater lure at a gun shop that shows a fish icon, anchor a boat near big fish and reel in; each catch gave +2%.
    5. Do it for Jason and Lucia separately. Once Focus is maxed it stays.

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 Petting animals gives +1%; go to the range

  111. Clean Jewelry Store Robbery: Shoot Every Camera, No Cops (Fear) 7:34

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 3: Tits, Ass, Drug Money, step 9: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs

    Once jewelry store robberies open, his way to rob one without the police: shoot every camera quickly and disable the alarm.

    How to do it

    1. Wear a mask and walk in without a gun out.
    2. Find and count every camera first.
    3. Draw your gun and shoot all the cameras quickly; he thinks you have about 15-20 seconds.
    4. Disable the alarm. In his store it was behind a door, with the last camera.
    5. When the camera icon at the top right goes away, no police come and you can loot at your own pace.
    6. Watch for witnesses phoning in your description: that is how the police find out.

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 Mask on, count the cameras, shoot them fast, disable the alarm
    2. 3:19 A second store without commentary

    Single source. The time limit is his guess, and about $21,000 from one store is his figure. He does not say which chapter he is in (a Key Cloner and an apartment suggest Chapter 3). He does not mention the camera footage that the guide's step says to destroy, so it is unclear whether shooting the cameras is enough on its own. Only two transcript stamps exist, so there are only two points.

  131. Free Thrax: Garage Clip Glitch (JFM) 2:35

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 3: Tits, Ass, Drug Money, step 18: No Flushers tags: free tracker-free Truffade Thrax

    Another take on clipping into Andrew Node's garage for the Thrax instead of doing the quest.

    How to do it

    1. Go to the mansion with the Thrax in its garage.
    2. Deal with the gate guard using a suppressed pistol so the police are not alerted.
    3. Reverse a car up to the garage door by the pillar between the two doors, leaving a gap of a few inches.
    4. Crouch in the gap between the car and the door.
    5. Keep opening and closing your phone while pressing enter vehicle (Y / Triangle) until you are thrown into the garage.
    6. Take the Thrax; register it at a Pay 'n' Spray or later in one of your garages.

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 The mansion, the guard and lining up the car
    2. 1:08 Phone and enter-vehicle spam
    3. 2:14 Inside: register it

    Near-duplicate of KaspaZ's garage clip at this step and Jay Dunna's wall clip. Whisper gives the area as 'Vyresteil County'; the guide puts the mansion in Sable Circle on Starfish Island. The $70K registration cost is his figure. Glitches may be patched.

    Where it fits: Chapter 3: Tits, Ass, Drug Money, step 18: No Flushers tags: free tracker-free Truffade Thrax

    The legitimate way to Andrew Node's Thrax: the No Flushers tags lead to the door code. Use it instead of the garage-clip glitch videos at this step.

    How to do it

    1. Scan all 10 No Flushers tags.
    2. Go to the No Flushers HQ, where you get the door code that leads to the car.
    3. Plan for the $70,000 registration before you take it.
    4. Leave the car alone until you can register it: he is not sure unique cars come back if lost.

    Near-duplicate of Arekkz Gaming's No Flushers video at this step, and the guide's step already has the full route and keypad code. Only the intro is commentary: tags 5, 7, 8 and 9 have chapter marks but just background dialogue, and there is no stamp for the other tags, the HQ or the car. The $70,000 registration matches the guide. Single source and unclear: his tip to get it in Chapter 2 so the free first registration at Moses covers it, while the guide places the quest in Chapter 3. 'Andu Node' and 'no flush HQ' are as heard.

  134. Rob Clothing Stores for Fast Cash (TheSpazo) 16:53

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 3: Tits, Ass, Drug Money, step 20: Vice City robbery opportunities: free cars, cash, uniques

    Clothing stores were his best quick cash, Vice City ones especially, with Kenton's dives as a steadier option.

    How to do it

    1. Pick clothing stores over other shop types; one other shop gave him $6.
    2. Vice City clothing stores paid the most in his run, a few hundred dollars each.
    3. Go at night: fewer cops and easier to lose them.
    4. Plan your escape first: if you die you lose all your cash.

    Key moments

    1. 1:02 Kenton's dives, then clothing stores
    2. 3:28 Other shops paid little
    3. 6:12 Robbing along the way
    4. 9:17 Vice City clothing stores
    5. 13:44 Night is easier; don't die with cash

    Recorded at launch, apparently still in Chapter 1 (Lucia calls from processing), so it works early too. About $3,000 over the whole video. Opens with a sponsor read for a paid account service, not covered here. Mostly unedited play, so tips are thin.

  141. How to Remove Advanced Trackers (TGG) 3:19

    Play here

    Where it fits: Chapter 4: Vice City, Baby, step 7: Unlock registering advanced-tracker cars

    What it takes to remove or register red (advanced) trackers: Randy's deliveries in Chapter 3, then his Mamba job in Chapter 4.

    How to do it

    1. In Chapter 3, deliver a good number of Randy's wishlist cars (not all of them).
    2. Keep calling Randy; he sends exact car locations.
    3. About halfway through Chapter 4 Randy texts asking for a Declasse Mamba; deliver it.
    4. He then texts that you can remove advanced trackers or register cars that have them.
    5. Next he asks for a Truffade Thrax; delivering it opens a final delivery job that gives a free Pegasi Tempesta.

    Key moments

    1. 0:00 Chapter 3: Randy and yellow trackers
    2. 1:05 Chapter 4: the Mamba unlocks it
    3. 2:10 Fastest route, the Thrax and the Tempesta

    Whisper hears 'Mamber' and 'Mambo GT'; the guide calls it the Mamba GT. He says it is unclear which Chapter 4 mission triggers the call. Single source for the free Pegasi Tempesta. The area name 'Belleville' may be misheard.
